glassmorphism.usage: Headers, Floating Navs, Modal Overlays, and Hero Cards

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing: use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped layouts.
layouts.bento_grid: Grid columns: 1 md:12, gap-8. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create tension.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Tight grid: gap-6. Summary (col-span-1), Main Chart (col-span-3).

buttons.primary: bg-[#2C5545] text-white hover:bg-[#234437] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors shadow-md hover:shadow-lg
buttons.glass: bg-white/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/40 text-[#2C5545] hover:bg-white/80 rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all

cards.dashboard: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow p-6
cards.product: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden group cursor-pointer

navigation.header: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border-b border-white/40

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glass meets APCA minimums. Use text-slate-900 or text-[#2C5545] on light glass.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='doctor-login-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Shadcn UI for dashboard elements, forms, dialogs, and tables.
Implement a role-based layout wrapper (different sidebars/navs based on role).
Use standard HTML+Tailwind with generous spacing (bento grid) for the landing page.
Ensure glassmorphism doesn't compromise readability (always add white backing if content behind is too noisy).
Add 'data-testid' to all key elements for testing.
Do not use generic centralized layouts. Avoid default Vercel-look.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds under text. Always use glass with a backdrop blur and background color tint.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use asymmetrical grids where possible.
Create depth with glass-morphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70) and layered z-index.
Do not apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Never center align the main App container with text-align: center.
Use pill-shaped buttons for modern, professional feel.
No AI emojis for icons; strictly use lucide-react.
Do not use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided high-quality image assets.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Ensure high contrast across all states (hover/active/focus). Ensure interactive elements have sufficient padding and touch targets are minimum 44x44px. Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
